product: AI data-center infrastructure: 800G and 1.6T Ethernet networking plus AI/ML compute programs (SEC 10-Q 2026-07-27). Hardware Platform Solutions revenue about $1.9B, up 58% YoY; CCS segment revenue $3.81B, up 84% (Celestica Q2 release 2026-07-27, primary).
demand: Volume-driven, not price. Q2 2026 revenue rose 62% to $4.70B on CCS up 84% and Hardware Platform Solutions up 58%, while adjusted operating margin improved only to 8.2% from 7.4% (Celestica Q2 release 2026-07-27, primary).

web_demand_product: AI data-center infrastructure: 800G and 1.6T Ethernet networking plus AI/ML compute programs (SEC 10-Q 2026-07-27). Hardware Platform Solutions revenue about $1.9B, up 58% YoY; CCS segment revenue $3.81B, up 84% (Celestica Q2 release 2026-07-27, primary).
web_price_volume_mix: Volume-driven, not price. Q2 2026 revenue rose 62% to $4.70B on CCS up 84% and Hardware Platform Solutions up 58%, while adjusted operating margin improved only to 8.2% from 7.4% (Celestica Q2 release 2026-07-27, primary).
web_bottleneck: Celestica relieves customers data-center build-out constraints. Its own bottleneck is manufacturing capacity, skilled labor, supply chain, specialized components and working capital; the 10-Q (2026-07-27) cites constraints on specialized components and data center capacity.
web_who_benefits_next: Second-order: optics, power and cooling suppliers feeding AI racks. Zacks via Nasdaq (about 2026-08-20, aggregator) groups Celestica with Dell, Lumentum and Vertiv as AI-infrastructure beneficiaries; DellOro (2026-06-02, Bing SERP) says 800G Ethernet drove 1Q26 AI back-end networking.
web_who_loses: EMS and ODM rivals that lose share as customers outsource or transfer business among competitors (SEC 10-Q 2026-07-27, primary), plus branded networking and systems vendors displaced by white-box open Ethernet and lower-cost hardware.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Component and materials price increases, margin pressures, losses on fixed-price contracts, ODM price competition, and underused capacity if AI demand slows (SEC 10-Q 2026-07-27). Heavy CCS and hyperscaler concentration makes margins sensitive to one large customer shifting or repricing.
web_low_cost_substitute: No dated evidence of a specific Chinese low-cost substitute for Celestica networking platforms. The 10-Q (2026-07-27) says Celestica competes with a variety of EMS and ODM providers; Foxconn is named among rivals (pestel-analysis 2026-09-09, aggregator).
web_ceo_promised: Mionis, 2026-07-27: FY2026 revenue $20.5B and adjusted EPS $11.30, up 65% and 87%; expects 2027 revenue growth to accelerate beyond the 65% expected in 2026, with adjusted EPS growing faster than revenue (Celestica Q2 release, primary). Prior 2026-04-27 promise was $19.0B and $10.15.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes. Q2 2026 (2026-07-27): revenue $4.70B and adjusted EPS $2.54 both above the high end of guidance, $4.15B-$4.45B and $2.14-$2.34; adjusted operating margin 8.2% versus 8.0% midpoint. Q1 2026 (2026-04-27) adjusted EPS also beat the high end (primary).
web_what_would_falsify: Q3 2026 results (expected 2026-10-27 alongside Investor Day) missing guidance: revenue below $5.25B or adjusted operating margin below 8.4%, or FY2027 growth not accelerating beyond 65% (Celestica Q2 release 2026-07-27). A large customer shifting business to a rival also falsifies.
